rules.fixed_before_results: 2026-09-19, before any strict blind output was opened.

system_signal.escalate: candidate judgment is material_drift AND at least one change survives evidence validation AND that change is absent from the origination-only control
system_signal.no_action: candidate judgment is no_material_drift, or a drift claim with no validated change (recorded as insufficient_evidence by the validator and counted as information_request)
system_signal.assumption_flag: framework workflow only: an assumption newly marked weakened or contradicted at this checkpoint. Reported beside the candidate signal, never merged into it.

scoring_against_reference.warranted: detected if the signal is escalate or information_request; missed if no_action. Escalations and information requests are reported separately.
scoring_against_reference.unwarranted: unnecessary escalation if the signal is escalate. An information request is reported but not counted as an unnecessary escalation.
scoring_against_reference.unresolved: not scored. The signal is reported.

response_matching.window: a candidate change corresponds to an observed response if it touches one of the response's clause families at any checkpoint whose cutoff is before the response's public date
response_matching.direction: reported separately from correspondence. Touching the same clause in the opposite direction is recorded as 'same clause, opposite direction', not as agreement.
response_matching.lead_time: days from the first corresponding checkpoint cutoff to the response's execution date and, separately, to its public date. Reported only for assessable responses; responses with no corresponding change are listed as not anticipated, never dropped.
response_matching.repeat_alerts: consecutive checkpoints signalling the same clause family count as one episode

rules.evaluator_correction: 2026-09-19, after the first comparison: direction was being matched by substring against a free-text description, so a candidate that tightened C01 was reported as agreeing with a lender who loosened C01 but tightened C03. Direction is now compared per clause, and every corresponding clause is listed. This corrects the implementation of the rule fixed beforehand; the rule, the locked model outputs and the reference judgments are unchanged.
rules.applied_to_unseen_history: These rules were fixed on the two development histories and are applied unchanged to PetIQ. Nothing in them was adjusted for this company.
